_doc: Facts that must live in the repository and nowhere only else. Project memory, tool memory and chat are not storage (Rowan, 2026-11-12), so each fact here carries a probe into a repo file; `python3 -m foundation directive --check` fails when a probe fails, i.e. when a fact exists only outside the repo. Add a fact here in the same PR that learns it. Changed only by a reviewed PR.

facts.statement: QNFO's public repository has a licence: the QNFO User License Agreement v2.1 (no commercial use). Never state it has none.

facts.statement: Ultrastable is an autonomous business system; its brand is separate from QNFO (no research framing; financials not claimed).

Rowan is the ideas person, not the business person; virtual managers own business, marketing, funding, legal/IP and ops; works by voice and vibe, no manual steps.
